description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'LDAPUserSyncAPI' for handling LDAP user synchronization in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to trigger a LDAP sync operation, retrieve the last sync status, and manage related LDAP sync status records. The class is part of the API module and uses several traits and services for authentication, configuration, and LDAP sync logic.
